lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: By the way,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: how did you get them to go along with it?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: The board.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I doubt they would've agreed to these terms without protest,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: let alone stopped interfering, as seems to be the case.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How do you think I did it?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I threatened them.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You're the one who gave me the means to do so.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I simply put it to proper use.
A few days earlier, at a standard Missilis Industry board meeting...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I got your little gift, everyone.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Heheh, I'd been wondering what sort of trick you were going to pull.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You gave the subjects a drug that would react to external heat,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: essentially turning them into bombs by spiking their internal temperatures.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You made it so that no matter what we did, we'd never find the cause.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The ones who took the drug all melt away,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: the experiment ends in failure and draws the attention of the press,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: and I'm sure you figured that if you torched the facility, you'd get rid of all the evidence.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Unfortunately for you...
*Thunk*
Syuen sets the medicine container down on the table.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I found a little something.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: I haven't the faintest idea what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: What proof do you have that we brought that into the lab?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Heh, I figured that's what you'd say.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And you're right. There's technically no proof you did it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: But that's fine. It doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Because I have no intention of using this to prove anything, either.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: In response to the public outrage,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: we can just throw some money at the protesters and bereaved families and they'll quiet down.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: As for the eight who melted, so long as we build a proper Matis Nikke and show the world what she can do,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: everyone will change their tune and start calling them a "noble sacrifice."

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: So then why do you think I showed this to you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Aren't you curious?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You.
Syuen points at a female board member.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You take supplements every morning, don't you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Do you remember what they look like?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And you. You went to the hospital yesterday. Or was it the day before?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Do you know every last ingredient of the medicine they gave you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And you, next to her. You had an Evergreen treatment a week ago, yes?

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: What do you think you're doing, Syuen?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Easy now. Don't get too worked up.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Wouldn't want things to get too heated in here, right?

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: Y-you can't mean...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You're the ones who showed me how to do it,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: how to melt a person without leaving a shred of evidence.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm literally just giving you a taste of your own medicine.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: You're saying that you already fed that to us...?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Oh, I just remembered... They said it's going to be hot outside today.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If you don't want to die, maybe you should ask Enikk to adjust the temperature.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Or you could turn on the AC at home and never set foot outside.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Oh! Or maybe go to the bathroom and wait for it to pass naturally.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You never know! The drug might come out the other end without any trouble at all.

lines.speaker: femaleexecutive
lines.text: Syuen...!
*Bam!*
Syuen pounds on the desk in front of the female executive.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Listen carefully.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You seem to be under the impression that I'm still that same hopeless little girl trembling up on the podium,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: but if you step out of line one more time and lay a finger on what's mine, I'll light a fire right next to you while you sleep.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I will melt every one of you from the inside the second you rub me the wrong way.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Is that clear?
The room falls silent.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Heh, finally a little peace and quiet in here.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Well then, do pray for my project's success.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm sure even good-for-nothings like you can manage that, right?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You mean those pills?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah. One look at the container and they all practically wet themselves, saying they'd never pull anything like that again.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So they just admitted to it...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What were they going to do, deny it? I already knew.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Yeah, I guess that's true.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: If you already know as the CEO, then there's not much they can do.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Regardless, I'll be ramping up security way more than before, so you won't have to worry about...

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Breaking news!

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: This morning, a female executive of Missilis Industry identified only as Ms. A was discovered dead at her home.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Reports indicate she was found lying in bed with burns caused by extreme heat covering her entire body. This shocking turn of events comes...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What...? Burns all over her body...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That sounds exactly like...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Oh my... What a vicious world we live in.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And one of our executives, no less? Whoever did it must have really hated her. Maybe she should've treated people better...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syuen...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What? What are you getting all serious for?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You said you only threatened them, right...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Of course! What, you think I went to their houses and set them on fire?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: When would I have even had time for that?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Haha! That's true! You've been so swamped with Matis that there's no way you could've done it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Look, I just reminded them of who they're dealing with so they'd get in line.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Oh really? Look at you, all grown up now!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Confronting the board and bringing the hammer down on them...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're starting to sound like a proper CEO.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I guess I can't call you a pipsqueak anymore.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Were you still thinking of me as a kid this whole time...?
Maxwell pats Syuen on the head.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... Just keep doing what you're doing, okay?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Er, Maxwell...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Why are you talking like that? You sound like you're planning on leaving.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: No, it's just...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: When the lab caught fire and I was trapped inside,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I wasn't expecting Laplace to come save me.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I figured I might die, and all sorts of thoughts started to run through my mind,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: like how I won't be able to be by your side forever.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: And, honestly, that's how it should be if you're ever going to stand on your own two feet.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Why would you think that...?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Come on, have you ever thought about how old I am?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Sure, Evergreen keeps me as limber as I was in my younger days,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: but believe it or not, I've been here at Missilis since your father's day.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: And since I'm only human, there'll come a time when my mind starts to age.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: When that happens, I'll have to hand this post over to someone young, whose intellect is still sharp.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Then I'll take my fat severance package,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: and go throw money around on Royal Road, bragging about how I have dinner every weekend with the CEO of Missilis.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Then I'll go off of Evergreen, grow old gracefully, and die a peaceful death. Isn't that how it should be?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... I don't know.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Instead of dwelling on that sort of thing, you should put your mind to upgrading Laplace's weapons.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Don't be thinking about retirement already.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Haha! Right, of course.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: We haven't even finished our cheeky pipsqueak of a CEO's first hero.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I gotta do my best to make sure she turns out perfect!
Maxwell rises from her seat.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: All right, now that the weapon adjustments are done,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: what do you say we get this project rolling again?
After Project Matis resumes,
Syuen builds an entirely new research team, choosing based purely on ability.
Laplace, the only participant left,
has her body personally readjusted by Syuen and Maxwell.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Now, we're going to inject electrical energy to push your core's output to its maximum.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Do you remember the injections you had before you got this body?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Yeah! They made me nauseous, and it felt like my insides were burning!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Right. That injection was meant to give you a preview of the procedure to determine whether you could handle it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: This new one will be several times worse than that one. It'll feel like your body's being torn apart.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Oh! I... see!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: ... Of course!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Then let's begin.
Syuen presses the injection button.
*Bzzz*
Energy begins flowing in through the tube plugged into Laplace's spine.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Agh!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Ngh... It feels... like I'm dying...!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: But I can... take it!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Good. Just hold out a little longer.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We have to do this to bolster your energy output.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Got... it!
The energy injection boosts every feature of Laplace's body.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: By the way, why don't you ever use your antennae?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Antennae?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Those things that look like horns on your head.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: They detect electrical signals so you can tell what's around you.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: In theory, you should be able to pinpoint the location of everyone on this floor,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: but I don't think I've ever seen you actually do anything like that.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Electrical... signals?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Am I supposed to feel them?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Yeah. The antennae on your head detect them.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Oh, I got it! I'm gonna try taking in the electrical signals with my whole body!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What?
Laplace flings her arms up toward the sky.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Electrical signals, come to me!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I'll take all of you!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'm starting to feel like this is a waste of good tech.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Does she really need something so refined?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... No, let's save it for whoever's next.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Good idea.
They overhaul the body's essential components to better suit Laplace.
After a long time filled with a great deal of effort,
the day of the last test finally arrives.
Fitted with a new Nikke body specifically tailored to her,
Laplace stands at the center of the simulation room.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h_op_r
lines.text: All right, we're proceeding with the final test.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h_op_r
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I'm feeling extremely good about my new body!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I get that you're excited, but you've got to take this seriously.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It's the last test before you head out for a real battle.

lines.speaker: laplace_op
lines.text: Of course!
Syuen looks back and forth at the two, first at Laplace's back as she stands in the simulation room,
and then down at Maxwell, who is talking with Laplace while watching the operation monitor.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You're saying...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: this won't last forever?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Hm? What was that, Syuen?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Nothing. Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Just do your best.

lines.speaker: laplace_op
lines.text: You got it, Syuen! I'm gonna give it all I got!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: All right, let's get started!

lines.speaker: laplace_op
lines.text: I'm ready!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Initiating simulation!
